title: Bhavesh Busa on Lenny's Podcast with Eric Ries
summary: TrackGenie co-founder hears Eric on Lenny's Podcast, orders the book by the end of the episode.
blockquote: I came across it through Lenny Rachitsky's Podcast – a long conversation with Eric that's worth the full listen. By the end of the episode, I had the book on order.
